dependencies: Node >=20, installed Git and authenticated GitHub CLI; delegates all network/repository actions to those canonical CLIs

operations.check: Validate scoped registry and npm scripts; no network or repository mutation.
operations.inspect: Read account/repository permission, exact remote main SHA and optional PR metadata/checks; no mutation.
operations.publish: Push only own clean named branch with exact requested head; create or reuse PR against explicit main/base SHA. No force push, branch switch or merge.
operations.review: Post attributed actual independent review evidence as a native PR review on exact reviewed commit; never fabricate account approval.
operations.merge: Merge only explicit own-lane PR/head into exact main base after four successful CI jobs and attributed exact-head independent review; uses GitHub's expected-head guard, no admin bypass or branch deletion.

limits: Repository-specific release facade, not an automatic updater or generic authority manager. External review evidence remains owner-verified. GitHub provides an atomic head guard but not an expected-base guard; base is checked immediately before mutation and the result must be verified. No installation or global PATH mutation.
